blocks.prompt: 7. The arithmetic mean between two positive numbers \(a\) and \(b\) is double their geometric mean. Prove that \(a : b = 2 + \sqrt{3} : 2 - \sqrt{3}\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh ratio (nisbat) ke baare mein proof hai. "A.M., G.M. ka double hai" se \(a\) aur \(b\) mein ek equation milti hai.
Humein \(\frac{a}{b}\) chahiye, is liye har term ko \(b\) se divide karenge aur \(t = \sqrt{a/b}\) rakhenge; is se \(t\) mein quadratic ban jayegi.
Plan: \(t\) nikalenge (\(a > b\) le kar), \(\frac{a}{b} = t^{2}\) banayenge, aur dikhayenge ke yeh \(\frac{2 + \sqrt{3}}{2 - \sqrt{3}}\) ke barabar hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(a, b > 0\) aur \(A = 2G\).
Saabit karna hai: \(a : b = 2 + \sqrt{3} : 2 - \sqrt{3}\).
Tareeqa: \(A = \frac{a+b}{2}\) aur \(G = \sqrt{ab}\). Jumle ko equation banayenge, phir sirf ratio \(\frac{a}{b}\) par kaam karenge, kyunke sawal \(a\) aur \(b\) ki alag qeemat nahi, sirf un ki nisbat maang raha hai.

Equation likhein
\[\dfrac{a + b}{2} = 2\sqrt{ab}\]
\[a + b = 4\sqrt{ab}\]
Kyun: "Double" ka matlab 2 guna: A.M. \(= 2 \times\) G.M. Phir fraction hatane ke liye dono taraf 2 se multiply kiya.

Har term ko \(b\) se divide karein
\[\dfrac{a}{b} + 1 = 4\sqrt{\dfrac{a}{b}}\]
Kyun: Humein \(\frac{a}{b}\) chahiye, is liye \(b\) se divide kiya. Square root wale term mein \(b > 0\) hai, to \(b = \sqrt{b^{2}}\), aur \(\frac{\sqrt{ab}}{b} = \sqrt{\frac{ab}{b^{2}}} = \sqrt{\frac{a}{b}}\).
Dhyan dein: Root ke andar \(b\) se divide karte waqt \(b^{2}\) aata hai, sirf \(b\) nahi.

\(t = \sqrt{a/b}\) rakhein
\[t^{2} + 1 = 4t\]
\[t^{2} - 4t + 1 = 0\]
Kyun: Naya variable (badalne wali miqdar) lene se root wali equation saaf quadratic ban jati hai. \(t^{2} = \frac{a}{b}\) hai, yaad rakhiye.

Quadratic formula lagayein
\[t = \dfrac{4 \pm \sqrt{16 - 4}}{2}\]
\[= \dfrac{4 \pm 2\sqrt{3}}{2}\]
\[= 2 \pm \sqrt{3}\]
Kyun: Yeh whole numbers se factorise nahi hoti, is liye formula \(t = \frac{-B \pm \sqrt{B^{2} - 4AC}}{2A}\) lagaya, jahan \(A = 1, B = -4, C = 1\). \(\sqrt{12} = 2\sqrt{3}\), phir har hissa 2 se divide.

Sahi root chunein
\[t = 2 + \sqrt{3}\]
Kyun: Hum \(a\) ko bara number lete hain (\(a > b\)), to \(\frac{a}{b} > 1\) aur \(t > 1\). \(2 - \sqrt{3} \approx 0.27\) jo 1 se chhota hai, aur \(2 + \sqrt{3} \approx 3.73\) jo 1 se bara hai.

Sawal wali ratio ko simplify karein
\[\dfrac{2 + \sqrt{3}}{2 - \sqrt{3}} = \dfrac{(2 + \sqrt{3})^{2}}{(2 - \sqrt{3})(2 + \sqrt{3})}\]
\[= \dfrac{7 + 4\sqrt{3}}{4 - 3}\]
\[= 7 + 4\sqrt{3}\]
Kyun: Neeche se surd hatane ke liye rationalise (jazr se paak) kiya: upar neeche \(2 + \sqrt{3}\) se multiply. Neeche \((x - y)(x + y) = x^{2} - y^{2}\) se \(4 - 3 = 1\) bacha.

Natija
\[\dfrac{a}{b} = \dfrac{2 + \sqrt{3}}{2 - \sqrt{3}}\]
\[a : b = 2 + \sqrt{3} : 2 - \sqrt{3}\]
Kyun: Dono taraf ek hi number \(7 + 4\sqrt{3}\) aaya, aur fraction ko ratio ki shakal mein likh sakte hain. Agar \(a < b\) lete to ratio ulti hoti: \(2 - \sqrt{3} : 2 + \sqrt{3}\).

Tasdeeq: numbers se
\[a = 7 + 4\sqrt{3},\ b = 1:\ \ \sqrt{ab} = 2 + \sqrt{3}\]
\[A = \dfrac{8 + 4\sqrt{3}}{2} = 4 + 2\sqrt{3} = 2G\]
Kyun: Upar dekha ke \((2 + \sqrt{3})^{2} = 7 + 4\sqrt{3}\), is liye G.M. \(2 + \sqrt{3}\) hai, aur A.M. bilkul us ka double nikla.
blocks.final_answer: Saabit ho gaya: \(a : b = 2 + \sqrt{3} : 2 - \sqrt{3}\) (\(a > b\) lete hue).
